title: Proof
body_md: By \eqref{eq:periodicity_IF}, $\mathcal{I}f(\cdot,v)$ is constant along geodesics in direction $v$ and by Theorem \ref{thm:FourierSlice} $\widehat{\mathcal{I}f}(k,v)=0$ when $k\cdot v \neq 0$. Thus, $\mathcal{I}f$ does not contribute to $e$ or $E_N$. Since $\mathcal{I}f\in H^r(\mathbb{T}^2\times Q)$ \cite[Proposition 10]{IKR19}, we have $g\in H^r(\mathbb{T}^2\times Q)$. If $\eta$ is constant along geodesics, $e\equiv 0$. Theorem \ref{thm:filtered-TBP} gives $g_N*p_{\alpha}^{s-r}\rightarrow f^{\alpha,s}$ in $H^{2s-r}(\mathbb{T}^2)$. By linearity and $\mathcal{I}^*\mathcal{I}=\text{Id}$ \cite[Proposition 11]{IKR19} we get $f^{\alpha, s}=P^{s-r}_\alpha f + P^{s-r}_\alpha\mathcal{I}^* \eta$. Since $\| \mathcal{I} \| = \|\mathcal{I}^*\|=1$ \cite[Propositions 10 and 11]{IKR19}, the first inequality follows from $\|P^{s-r}_\alpha\|_{H^r\rightarrow H^r}\leq 1$, and the second from $\|P^{s-r}_\alpha\|_{H^r\rightarrow H^{2s-r}}\leq \alpha^{-1}$ by \eqref{eq:filterupperbound}.
